headword: {大久保利通|おおくぼとしみち}

definitions.gloss: Ōkubo Toshimichi (1830–1878), Satsuma samurai and Meiji statesman
definitions.explanation: A samurai of Satsuma and one of the three great leaders of the Meiji Restoration. As Home Minister he drove the new government's modernization of industry and administration until he was assassinated in 1878.

examples.japanese: {大久保利通|おおくぼとしみち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{薩摩|さつま}→薩摩：33115_satsuma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出身|しゅっしん}→出身：03221_shusshin⟧だ。
{大久保利通|おおくぼとしみち}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{西郷隆盛|さいごうたかもり}→西郷隆盛：31133_saigoutakamori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{幼|おさな}なじみだった。
examples.english: Ōkubo Toshimichi and Saigō Takamori were childhood friends.

examples.japanese: {大久保利通|おおくぼとしみち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{内務卿|ないむきょう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{産業|さんぎょう}→産業：01419_sangyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{近代化|きんだいか}→近代化：15055_kindaika⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めた→進める：01949_susumeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、1878⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{暗殺|あんさつ}→暗殺：10142_ansatsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: As Home Minister, Ōkubo Toshimichi pushed forward the modernization of industry, but he was assassinated in 1878.

notes:
With ⟦{西郷隆盛|さいごうたかもり}→西郷隆盛：31133_saigoutakamori⟧ and {木戸孝允|きどたかよし} he is one of the ⟦{維新|いしん}→維新：13869_ishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{三傑|さんけつ}, the three great men of the Restoration. He and Saigō grew up in the same neighbourhood of Kagoshima, but they split in 1873 over the proposal to send an expedition to Korea, and Ōkubo's government put down Saigō's Satsuma Rebellion in 1877.
